title: Bind C102 artifact cardinality to the active diagram-artifact registry and register the xingcheng diagram family
summary: Active C102 still hardcodes 'five common architecture diagrams + seven independent tool architecture diagrams' as the atomic-sync artifact set, but the authoritative architecture_diagram_artifact_registry active set is nine artifacts (two common + seven tool) and now additionally carries the new four-file xingcheng family (architecture-xingcheng-architecture/capabilities/data/parameters.md), which the audit manifest already binds to text-no-pollution checks. The sync gate itself (A537/A538 ArchitectureDocs in GPTBridge.CodexPipeline) is already registry-driven and derives the expected set from canonical+independent_tool components, so only the law text carries the stale cardinality. This amendment (a) rewrites C102 to bind the artifact set to architecture_diagram_artifact_registry status=active rows instead of literal counts — the same version-neutrality direction as rev 199/200; (b) registers the four xingcheng diagram artifacts as active so the successor-transaction obligation actually covers them.
origin: direct human-governor instruction: architecture-law mismatch — active C102 artifact cardinality vs the registry active set and the on-disk xingcheng diagram family has not formally converged.

problem.summary: C102's literal artifact cardinality (5 common + 7 tool = 12) no longer matches the authoritative registry (9 active rows before this amendment, 13 after registering the xingcheng family); any future tool retirement/addition would re-break a hardcoded count. The binding must name the registry active set, not the count. The four xingcheng mirror docs are governed artifacts on disk (audit-manifest bound) but absent from the registry, so the sync law does not formally cover them yet.

changes.proposed: C102 補充 D75、D118、B118 與 B124。任何自動法典更新必須以單一受治理 successor transaction 同時產生並驗證：正式法典、五份有序中文法典鏡像、machine architecture registry，以及架構圖 artifact registry（architecture_diagram_artifact_registry）中 status=active 的全部架構圖——同步義務所及的 artifact 集合以權威登錄表之 active 集合為準，法典不釘固定數目或分類計數。提交前必須完成版本一致性、內容一致性、五分卷鏈結、架構來源條文、登錄資料與治理稽核檢查。全部目標成功後才能原子發布；任何一項缺失、失敗、過期或版本不同，必須回復整批候選並拒絕發布。
